title: Health
description: Say what is wrong and understand the advice.

questions.sentence: Aap kaise hain?

Main bazaar jaa raha hoon.
Mera naam Ahmed hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Main theek nahin hoon.

Mujhe biryani pasand hai.
Main abhi ghar aaya hoon.
questions.correctAnswer: Mere sar mein dard hai.

questions.translatedSentence: I have a cold.

questions.sentence: Aapke sar mein dard kab se hai?

My eyes are getting tired.

I have a mild pain in my knee.

Zara bahar tashreef rakhiye.

Mujhe abhi tak maloom nahin.

I feel hungry after I eat.

Nahin, mujhe dawa ka naam maloom hai.

I feel cold when I walk.

questions.sentence: Kya aapko kisi dawa se allergy hai?
options: Ji haan, ek dawa se allergy hai.
Ji haan, mujhe nihari bahut pasand hai.
Ji nahin, mujhe abhi waqt nahin mila.

options: The doctor has ordered a blood test for me.
The doctor has given me an injection.
The doctor has written down a new medicine for me.
questions.correctAnswer: The doctor has ordered a blood test for me.

questions.sentence: Fikr ki koi baat nahin hai.
options: Shukriya doctor sahib, tasalli ho gayi.
Shukriya, mujhe bahut bhookh lag rahi hai.
Maaf kijiye, mera parcha yahin rakha hai.

questions.sentence: Yeh dawa kitni baar leni hai?

Din mein teen rupay lagte hain.

This syrup is to be taken after a meal.
questions.correctAnswer: This tablet is to be taken after a meal.

questions.sentence: Kya aapke paas bukhar ka syrup hai?
options: Ji haan, bukhar ka syrup mauzood hai.
Ji haan, yeh dawa doctor ne likhi hai.
Ji nahin, aaj dukan band rahegi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ji haan, bukhar ka syrup mauzood hai.

options: Keep taking this medicine for five days.
Start taking this medicine after five days.
Keep taking this medicine for five weeks.
questions.correctAnswer: Keep taking this medicine for five days.

questions.sentence: Is dawa ki qeemat kitni hai?

Do sau saal purani hai.
Do hafte tak chalegi.
questions.correctAnswer: Do sau rupay ki hai.

questions.sentence: Khaali pet yeh dawa mat lijiye.
options: Do not take this medicine on an empty stomach.
Do not take this medicine right after a meal.
Take this medicine on an empty stomach.
questions.correctAnswer: Do not take this medicine on an empty stomach.

questions.sentence: Kya is dawa se neend aati hai?
options: Ji haan, thodi si neend aa sakti hai.
Ji haan, yeh dawa kaafi mehngi hai.
Ji nahin, yeh dawa bukhar ki nahin hai.

questions.translatedSentence: Yes, it can make you a little sleepy.

questions.sentence: Doctor ka parcha zara dikhaiye.
options: Please show me the doctor's prescription.
Please show me your identity card.
Please give this prescription to the doctor.
questions.correctAnswer: Please show me the doctor's prescription.

questions.sentence: Kya yeh dawa bacchon ke liye theek hai?
options: Nahin, bacchon ke liye alag syrup hai.
Haan, yeh dawa sirf raat ko leni hai.
Nahin, dukan subah nau baje khulti hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Nahin, bacchon ke liye alag syrup hai.
questions.translatedSentence: No, there is a separate syrup for children.

questions.sentence: Bukhar kitna tha?
options: Raat ko ek sau do bukhar tha.
Raat ko do baje aankh khul gayi thi.
Subah se khaansi bilkul nahin hai.
questions.correctAnswer: Raat ko ek sau do bukhar tha.
questions.translatedSentence: Last night the fever was a hundred and two.

questions.sentence: Khaansi raat ko zyada badh jaati hai.
options: The cough gets worse at night.
The cough gets better at night.
The fever gets worse at night.
questions.correctAnswer: The cough gets worse at night.

questions.sentence: Tumhein zukam kaise ho gaya?
options: Main baarish mein bheeg gaya tha.
Main bazaar mein der tak baitha tha.
Maine subah garam chai pi thi.

questions.translatedSentence: I got soaked in the rain.

questions.sentence: Haath se khoon nikal raha hai.
options: My hand is bleeding.
My hand is swollen.
My foot is bleeding.
questions.correctAnswer: My hand is bleeding.

questions.sentence: Kya aapne chot par patti bandh li hai?

Ji haan, dawa khareed li hai.
Ji nahin, bukhar utar gaya hai.

questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I have put a bandage on it.

options: I have had a sore throat for two days.
I have had a fever for two days.
I have had a sore throat since this morning.
questions.correctAnswer: I have had a sore throat for two days.

questions.sentence: Kya bukhar ke saath jism mein dard bhi hai?
options: Haan, poore jism mein dard hai.
Haan, mujhe garam chai chahiye.
Nahin, sirf haath par chot lagi hai.

options: Do not drink cold water when you have a high fever.
Do not drink hot water when you have a high fever.
Drink cold water when you have a high fever.
questions.correctAnswer: Do not drink cold water when you have a high fever.

questions.sentence: Ghutne mein moch aa gayi hai.
options: To phir barf lagaiye aur aaram kijiye.
To phir garam chai pi lijiye.
To phir zabaan dikha dijiye.
questions.correctAnswer: To phir barf lagaiye aur aaram kijiye.

Agar bukhar utar jaaye to hospital chale jaaiye.
questions.correctAnswer: Agar bukhar na utre to phir se dikha jaaiye.

questions.sentence: Main behtar to hoon, lekin abhi kamzori hai.
options: I am better, but I still feel weak.
I am better, and I feel strong now.
I am not better, because I feel weak.
questions.correctAnswer: I am better, but I still feel weak.

questions.sentence: Kya main kal daftar jaa sakta hoon?
options: Nahin, do din aur aaram kijiye kyunki kamzori hai.

Nahin, kyunki yeh dawa dukan par nahin milti.

questions.sentence: Dawa poori kijiye, warna takleef phir se ho sakti hai.
options: Finish the course of medicine, otherwise the trouble can come back.
Stop the medicine, otherwise the trouble can come back.
Finish the course of medicine, and the trouble will come back.

questions.sentence: Doctor sahib ne kya mashwara diya?
options: Kaha ki roz thodi der chalna chahiye.
Kaha ki roz raat ko nihari khani chahiye.
Kaha ki dawa lene ki zaroorat nahin hai.

questions.sentence: Agar aap aaram karenge to jald theek ho jaayenge.

You will get better soon, but you must not rest.

Drink warm water and eat something cold as well.
questions.correctAnswer: Drink warm water and stay away from cold things.

options: Ameen, aapki bahut meherbani.
Ameen, yeh dawa bahut mehngi hai.
Shukriya, main abhi bazaar jaa raha hoon.
